화면을 <color={0}>톡! 터치</color>하면

낚싯줄을 던져요!

Watch the needle move up and down,
then <color={0}>tap the screen</color>
to cast your line
to the depth you want!

화면을 <color={0}>쓱~ 문지르면</color>
갈고리가 좌우로 따라가요.
물건에 갈고리를 대면
저절로 걸려 올라와요!
en:
<color={0}>Swipe across the screen</color>
and the hook follows you.
Touch an item with the hook
and it gets reeled in!

ko:
한 번 출항하면 <color={0}>1분</color>이에요!
시간이 끝나기 전에
여러 번 던져서 고철을
최대한 많이 모아보세요.
en:
Each trip lasts <color={0}>1 minute</color>!
Cast again and again
and haul in as much scrap
as you can before time runs out.

ko:
잠수 칸 {1}개가 모두 찼어요!
화면을 <color={0}>위에서 아래로</color>
<color={0}>쓱~ 스와이프</color>하면
바닷속으로 잠수해요!
en:
All {1} dive slots are full!
<color={0}>Swipe down</color>
<color={0}>from top to bottom</color>
to dive into the sea!

ko:
아래 <color={0}>동그란 조이스틱</color>을
잡고 움직이면 물속을
마음대로 헤엄쳐요!
가까이 가기만 해도
고철이 저절로 붙어요.
en:
Hold and move the
<color={0}>round joystick</color> below
to swim freely!
Just get close to scrap
and it sticks to you.

ko: 자판기 옆에서 주운 빈 캔을 접은 미끼.
en: Bait made from an empty can found by a vending machine.
A spoon twisted from a plastic bag handle.

ko: 은색 구슬 세 알을 묶은 추.
en: A sinker made of three silver pachinko balls.
A fly wrapped in a soggy club flyer.
A single bolt that fell off the overpass.
A minnow with blinking pink LED petals.

ko: 간판 조각을 갈아 만든 회전 날개.
en: A spinner blade ground from a broken sign.
A lure with a holographic goldfish swimming inside.
A crankbait carved from a festival mask.
A scrapped satellite dish that pulls in signals.
Lures mutants with the glint of a forged blade.
Hacks the underwater sensor grid to gather prey.

ko: 여덟 갈래 훅이 한 번에 더 많은 스크랩을 부른다.
en: Eight-pronged hooks call in more scrap at once.
Moonlight pulses lure up deep-sea schools.

ko: 만(灣) 전체의 신호와 동기화되는 결정체 미끼.
en: A crystal bait synced with every signal in the bay.
Back-alley rod forge in Ameyoko Market

ko: 베란다 대나무 빨래 장대에 줄을 묶었다.
en: Line tied to a bamboo laundry pole from a balcony.

ko: 살 하나만 남은 비닐우산 손잡이 낚싯대.
en: A rod made from an umbrella with one rib left.
A selfie stick a tourist left behind, extended.
A folding antenna pulled from a junkyard car.

ko: 깨진 네온관 안에 LED를 채워 넣었다.
en: A cracked neon tube stuffed with LEDs.
A 3-piece folding rod that fits in a briefcase.

ko: 전철 집전 장치를 개조한 탄성 로드.
en: A springy rod made from a train pantograph.
Holographic cherry petals drift along the line.
Talisman-wrapped, it charms scrap as it wishes.
A rod carved from a cursed blade.

ko: 전자기 레일로 바늘을 깊이 쏘아 보낸다.
en: Fires the hook deep on an electromagnetic rail.

ko: 번개가 줄을 타고 내려가 주변 스크랩까지 끌어온다.
en: Lightning runs down the line and drags in nearby scrap.
A harpoon-style rod once wielded by the storm god.

ko: 바다를 휘저어 섬을 만든 신화의 창과 동기화된 결정 로드.
en: A crystal rod synced with the mythic spear that stirred the sea into islands.
Used-boat broker at the abandoned Odaiba docks
Six tires lashed into a raft.
A barge pieced together from fish crates.
An umbrella sail catches a little wind.
A flipped vending machine with a motor bolted on.

ko: 택배 컨테이너 두 개를 띄운 부선.

en: A ramen stall and floating trading post in one.
Capsule rooms used as storage for goods.
Its sign lights draw black-market traders.

ko: 선상 서버가 실시간 시세를 긁어 온다.

en: Comes with connections to a regular fence.
A streamlined hull steadies your depth aim.

ko: 붉은 도리이 아래에서는 값이 더 붙는다.
en: Things sell for more beneath the red torii.

ko: 만 위에 뜬 천상의 방주. 모든 거래가 이 배를 거친다.
en: A heavenly ark floating over the bay. Every deal passes through it.
Cries for food like a Tamagotchi.
Its alarm is broken, so it's quiet.
A crow-shaped scout that spots hazards first.
Waves its paw to beckon scrap.
Cuts through currents with a koi tail.
Slips between hazards with optical camo.

ko: 벌떼형 소형 드론이 주변을 쓸어 담는다.
en: A swarm of bee drones sweeps up everything nearby.
Talisman paper cranes fetch scrap for you.
Snatches loot with its long-nosed claws.

ko: 북을 울려 위험물을 한 번 튕겨 낸다.
en: Beats its drums to deflect a hazard once.
Nine tail drones collect from every direction.
A crystal drone synced with an orbital satellite.
Golden Gai back-alley angler hiring hall
Just a life vest over the store uniform.
Fishing under the overpass for 30 years.
Wears fishing line wrapped around his hard hat.

ko: 바다가 썩기 전을 기억하는 마지막 세대.
en: The last generation that remembers the sea before it rotted.
Trying to fish back the money he lost.
30K subscribers on her live fishing stream.
Catches his own soup stock ingredients.
Laid off, now he commutes to the sea.
Extended her delivery routes to the canals.
Cuts through the deep with prosthetic fins.
Swings his rod like a sword.

ko: 수중 센서를 해킹해 손맛을 미리 안다.
en: Hacks underwater sensors to feel a bite before it happens.
The legendary fisher said to have caught a giant sea monster.

ko: 용궁의 길을 아는 무녀. 바다가 길을 연다.
en: A shrine maiden who knows the way to the Dragon Palace. The sea opens a path for her.

ko: 크롬 의수와 크리스탈 결정을 두른 각성 엣지러너. 네오도쿄 바다와 완전히 싱크로한 유일한 낚시꾼.
en: An awakened edgerunner clad in chrome limbs and crystal shards. The only angler fully synced with Neo-Tokyo's sea.

A convenience-store bucket with a plastic window.

Swim goggles taped to a hard hat.
Layers of tape over every leak.
The previous owner's name sticker is still on it.
A fluorescent visor that lights up murky water.
A commuter smog mask converted for diving.

en: A nano-coated glass dome that repels wastewater.

A brass pressure helmet for exploring the Dragon Palace.

en: An artificial breathing filter cuts oxygen use.
Company gear with the Shinzen logo scratched off.
